baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ ... وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَاءٍ أَمْرَهَا
baseline_models.mechanism: Effective, completed making is followed by hidden delivery of an obligatory charge to every layer; the seven heavens are therefore finished as individually commissioned units, not merely accumulated matter.

activation_trace.role: Well-wrought making and effective execution supply the constitutive completion of the seven units.
Hidden delivery of knowledge supplies the transmission that commissions each finished unit.
Comprehensive inclusion makes the distribution exhaustive across the layers.
Binding request or command supplies the operative charge assigned within each heaven.
Deliberative preparation and exact arrangement frame the commissions as one designed system.

changed_reading.before: Seven heavens were made and each was informed of its affair.
changed_reading.after: Seven differentiated operational units were brought to effective completion and each was privately commissioned with its own charge.

baseline_models.mechanism: The nearest overlying canopy is made visibly luminous and simultaneously guarded; display and defense form a coupled boundary function.

activation_trace.role: What rises and overshadows supplies the canopy-like spatial layer.
Nearness places this layer at the proximal interface of the ordered heavens.
Lamps and celestial luminaries supply the visible signaling surface.
Making beauty manifest turns luminosity into deliberate public display.
Watchful guarding gives the same visible layer a defensive perimeter function.

changed_reading.before: The lowest heaven was decorated with lamps and also protected.
changed_reading.after: The nearest canopy is a luminous guarded threshold whose visibility and perimeter control belong to one design.

baseline_models.mechanism: Number, duration, completion, and measured limit converge: plurality is counted, formation is temporally bounded, and the result is declared calibrated.

activation_trace.role: Finishing and bringing to term close the formation process.
The explicit number supplies discrete structural count.
A duration of time supplies a bounded production interval without requiring an ordinary daylight day.
A quantity reaching its proper limit makes count and duration jointly calibrating.
Complete cognition grounds the precision of the calibration.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a number of heavens and a creation duration.
changed_reading.after: Count and duration are mutually constraining specifications in a knowingly bounded act of completion.

baseline_models.mechanism: A non-dominant mapped inventory lets the repeated heaven root activate visible marking and diagnostic signs; lamps then function as legible marks on elevated layers, while knowledge names their intelligibility.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark by which something is known supplies a secondary semiotic image for the repeated heavens.
A sign from which a condition is inferred makes the marked surface evidentiary rather than merely decorative.
Celestial lamps provide the actual visible marks carried by the nearest layer.
A distinguishing sign that guides supplies the link from visible marking to knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are elevated locations, one of which bears lights.
changed_reading.after: The elevated layers can also be carried as legible marked surfaces, with the nearest layer's lights acting as diagnostic signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening presents revelation as a delivered book whose signs are differentiated in detail, then repeats revelation to the messenger. Against that sequence, completing seven heavens and communicating each one's affair becomes a cosmic analogue of articulation: a whole is divided into addressable units and each unit receives determinate content.

activation_trace.role: Decisive conveyance gives the focus completion a communicative edge alongside its constitutive force.
Writing or inscription supplies an articulated-record image for the charge placed in each layer.
Each heaven's own affair supplies the differentiated content of the cosmic articulation.
Caused descent and delivery supply the surah's initial transmission frame.
A fixed writing that obliges judgment or measure links textual inscription to effective cosmic ordinance.
Detailing that exposes parts and meanings supplies the division of one whole into distinct intelligible units.
A manifest sign makes each differentiated unit capable of bearing disclosed meaning.
Divine revelation to the messenger supplies the explicit human-side counterpart to revelation within every heaven.

structural_cues: The surah opens with descent, book, detailed signs, and knowing readers in that order.
The same و ح ي form occurs at 41:6 for revelation to the human messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two revelation scenes and a book detailed into signs; I supply the analogy that the sevenfold completion is a cosmic articulation into commissioned units. A live alternative is that the focus revelation is only a decree with no textual analogy.

changed_reading.before: Each completed heaven receives an operational command.
changed_reading.after: Creation itself is articulated like a differentiated communiqué: the sevenfold whole is partitioned into addressable units and each unit receives its determinate content.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate creation sequence measures earth's sustenance for askers, stabilizes it, and elicits willing response from smoke-like heaven and earth. The focus commands can therefore be read as the layer-specific operating assignments of one obedient provisioning and preservation network.

activation_trace.role: Effective construction turns the responsive material of the prior verse into finished functional layers.
An obligatory charge supplies the operating instruction for each layer.
Prepared and calculated arrangement integrates the layer assignments with terrestrial provisioning.
Guarding supplies the preservation function within the larger service network.
Estimating and measuring a thing makes terrestrial creation part of the same calibrated process.
Measured preparation of sustenance supplies the concrete provisioning task to which cosmic assignments can contribute.
Standing over something in preservation, power, and witness unites sustenance with the focus roles of guarding and knowing.
Equality between recipients supplies the distributive constraint on measured provision.
Rising smoke supplies the unfinished material state transformed by the focus completion.
Willing obedience supplies the response mode by which heaven and earth enter their assigned functions.

structural_cues: Earth is created in two days, its sustenance is measured in four, and the heavens are completed in two.
Heaven and earth are directly addressed at 41:11 and jointly answer that they come willingly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured sustenance, equal access, responsive material, and willing obedience; I infer that each heaven's charge operationalizes this coordinated provisioning order. The live alternative is that the charges are decrees unrelated to sustenance.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are completed according to a precise plan.
changed_reading.after: The heavens become an obedient, calibrated service network whose layer-specific charges support provision, stability, and preservation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, bodily materials testify and God makes every thing speak. This activates the possibility that heavens receiving their own affairs are not inert containers but commissioned, responsive bearers capable of disclosing the order placed in them.

activation_trace.role: Hiddenly imparted knowledge supplies content that a commissioned layer can later manifest.
Exhaustive inclusion extends responsive capacity to every heaven.
Each layer's own affair supplies the particular content it bears and performs.
Knowledge disclosed to a knower frames the cosmic order as intelligible and revealable.
Testimony that states something from knowledge supplies the evidentiary action of created material.
Being made to speak supplies explicit responsiveness rather than inert containment.
The statement that every thing can be made articulate broadens the possible agency of each heaven.
Unconcealed divine knowledge supplies the ground on which material testimony is reliable.

structural_cues: Hearing, sight, and skins testify at 41:20.
At 41:21 the creator of all things is said to make them speak.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speaking and testifying created materials; I extend that created responsiveness to the heavens because each is explicitly addressed with its own affair. The live alternative is that speech here is exceptional to judgment and says nothing about cosmic function.

changed_reading.before: Each heaven is an operational unit carrying an assigned function.
changed_reading.after: Each heaven can also be carried as a responsive bearer of knowledge, commissioned to perform and potentially disclose its assigned order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later shows adornment used to beautify a false field of perception, while sun and moon are visible signs that must not become objects of worship. The focus coupling of adornment with guarding therefore reads as regulated sign-display: beauty reveals order but is kept from becoming its own authority.

activation_trace.role: Making beauty manifest supplies the luminous display whose epistemic use is at issue.
Celestial lamps provide concrete visible objects that can direct attention.
Guarding constrains and preserves the display rather than leaving beauty epistemically unregulated.
Manifest beautification here distorts perception, supplying the negative contrast that makes guarded adornment significant.
A manifest sign defines the celestial lights as evidence pointing beyond themselves.
The sun supplies one visible celestial sign explicitly denied independent worship.
The moon and its heavenly light supply the second visible sign denied independent worship.

structural_cues: At 41:25 companions beautify what lies before and behind people, and the result is loss.
At 41:37 night, day, sun, and moon are signs, but worship is redirected to their creator.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive adornment and non-worshiped celestial signs; I infer that the focus adjacency of adornment and guarding marks a disciplined display that preserves correct reference. A live alternative is that guarding is purely spatial and unrelated to perception.

changed_reading.before: The nearest heaven is aesthetically lit and physically defended.
changed_reading.after: Its lights form a guarded sign-display: their beauty discloses order while being denied the status of autonomous authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later book is called mighty and inaccessible to falsehood from either direction, then identified as a descent. Because the focus also joins hidden communication, guarding, and the Mighty, its nearest heaven can be read as preserving the integrity of transmitted order as well as defending space.

activation_trace.role: Writing and inscription supply the transmitted content whose integrity can be preserved.
Guarding supplies active preservation at the nearest cosmic boundary.
Might and impregnability ground the resistance of the ordered medium.
Ordered written content supplies the later medium explicitly described as mighty.
Might and inviolability characterize the book and activate the same quality in the focus design.
Loss of truth and stability names the contaminant that cannot enter the protected book.
Delivered descent links the inviolable book back to the focus's hidden communication.

structural_cues: The book is called عزيز at 41:41, repeating the focus epithet.
At 41:42 falsehood cannot approach it from before or behind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a protected, mighty transmission and a guarded cosmic layer under the Mighty; I infer a shared integrity mechanism between revelation and cosmic communication. The live alternative is that the repeated epithet marks only divine power and does not connect the two media.

changed_reading.before: Guarding protects the nearest heaven as a spatial perimeter.
changed_reading.after: Guarding also protects the integrity of a communicated order, making the nearest heaven an inviolable transmission medium parallel to the mighty book.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later use of ق ض ي for judgment between disputants activates the focus root's decisive legal branch. Joined to sevenfold division and each heaven's own authority-bearing affair, completion can be read as constituting distinct jurisdictions.

activation_trace.role: A decisive ruling supplies the constitutive act that partitions and settles the sevenfold order.
Exhaustive inclusion ensures that no heaven lies outside the constituted distribution.
Authority and delegated rule make each heaven's own affair resemble a jurisdictional competence.
Judgment between parties supplies the explicit adjudicative use that reactivates the legal force of the focus verb.
Separation and distinction supply the boundary-making effect of adjudication.

structural_cues: At 41:45 judgment between disputants is deferred because of a prior word.
The focus distributes an affair to each member of a sevenfold whole.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit later adjudicative use of the same verb; I project that constitutive force onto the focus and treat each assigned affair as a jurisdiction. The live alternative is the dominant manufacturing sense, with no legal partition intended.

changed_reading.before: Seven crafted layers each receive a function.
changed_reading.after: A decisive constitutive act establishes seven jurisdictions, each invested with its own sphere of charge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine knowledge later spans the hour, fruit emerging from coverings, hidden gestation, and birth. This turns focus تقدير from macroscopic count and schedule into fine-grained coordination of thresholds where concealed processes become manifest.

activation_trace.role: Temporal duration supplies the large-scale schedule that context will refine into event-level timing.
A thing reaching its measured limit supplies calibration at every scale.
Complete cognition grounds exact knowledge of hidden and manifest stages.
Knowledge encompassing both final time and reproductive detail supplies the context's scale-bridging precision.
Passage to the outside supplies the hidden-to-manifest threshold.
Ripened fruit supplies an outcome that appears only when its process reaches measure.
The plant's enclosing sheath supplies the concealed stage from which measured emergence occurs.
An inward load or fruit supplies the hidden developmental process.
Delivery in birth supplies the timed transition from carrying to manifest release.

structural_cues: At 41:47 knowledge of the hour is placed beside fruit emergence, pregnancy, and birth.
The focus closes its counted and timed construction with the epithet العليم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive knowledge of temporal and generative transitions; I infer that focus تقدير coordinates such thresholds rather than only fixing gross dimensions. A live alternative is that the closing phrase emphasizes sovereignty without specifying process-level timing.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are produced to a measured count and duration.
changed_reading.after: The same estimation reaches into event-level timing, coordinating when concealed processes in the ordered world cross into manifestation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing promise places signs in distant horizons and in selves until truth becomes manifest, then invokes witness over every thing. The focus lamps on the nearest heaven become the outward edge of a paired evidentiary field rather than isolated ornaments.

activation_trace.role: A visible distinguishing mark supplies the semiotic potential of the repeated heaven term.
Celestial lamps supply the observable marks at the outward horizon.
A mark that distinguishes and guides links cosmic visibility to cognition.
Manifest signs explicitly define what is shown in horizons and selves.
Distant regions and horizons locate the external field that includes the visible heavens.
The thing itself or its own self supplies the inward counterpart to horizon evidence.
Coming into view supplies the evidentiary result of the paired sign fields.
Testimony from knowledge makes the visible marks participate in a comprehensive witness structure.

structural_cues: At 41:53 signs are shown in horizons and selves until truth becomes clear.
The verse closes by invoking witness over every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward and inward signs that yield clarity; I identify the focus's celestial lamps as one outward sign-set because they occupy the nearest visible heaven. A live alternative is that the horizon signs refer to other phenomena and do not reactivate the lamps specifically.

changed_reading.before: The nearest heaven bears legible luminous marks.
changed_reading.after: Those lights participate in an outward evidentiary field paired with signs in selves, moving the focus from ornament to horizon-level disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final declaration of enclosure around every thing resolves through branches of ح و ط that combine preservation with complete enclosure in knowledge and secure possession. The focus's local guard and per-heaven distribution are thus nested expressions of total custody.

activation_trace.role: Overlying canopies supply the nested spatial layers held within the larger enclosure.
Exhaustive inclusion distributes the order through every heaven.
Guarding supplies the local preservation function at the nearest layer.
Complete knowledge supplies the cognitive dimension of custody.
Every thing extends the closing enclosure without remainder.
Preservation and protective custody directly reactivate the focus guard.
Complete enclosure in knowledge and secure possession unites the focus's guarding and knowing.

structural_cues: The focus says every heaven receives its affair and singles out guarding at the nearest layer.
The surah closes with God encompassing every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a closing root whose branches explicitly join preservation, knowledge, and enclosure; I treat the focus guard as a local manifestation of that total custody. The live alternative is that the closing enclosure is only omniscience, while focus guarding is a separate function.

changed_reading.before: Each heaven has a local assignment, and the nearest has a local guard.
changed_reading.after: The distributed assignments and nearest-layer guard are nested operations within comprehensive preserving and knowing custody.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relies on the non-dominant و س م and س م م mappings of the repeated heaven root, especially mark, aperture, and sealing branches. It remains anchored in the three focus occurrences of heaven, the lamps, and explicit guarding, and the branches form a coherent boundary mechanism. Downstream prose should present it only as a branch-generated material analogy, not as the lexical meaning of سماء or as evidence for literal gates.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَمَٰوَاتٍ ... سَمَآءٍ ... ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًا

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark lets the nearest heaven's lights act as boundary markers.
A narrow aperture through which something enters supplies a possible controlled-interface image.
Sealing and tightening supply closure and ingress control at that interface.
Celestial lamps supply visible markers on the proposed membrane.
Guarding supplies the membrane's selective protective function.
The inability of destabilizing falsehood to enter the later medium gives contextual support to controlled ingress.

changed_reading.before: The nearest heaven is a luminous guarded canopy.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it behaves like a marked, gated membrane whose luminous points identify a boundary while guarding regulates passage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a context branch for حمل moves directly from female gestation to a load in sky or cloud, inviting a cross-domain reading of celestial layers as carriers. It remains anchored in سماء, each layer's affair, تقدير, and العليم, with context supplying concealment and emergence. Downstream prose should call this a process analogy for carrying latent outcomes, never a claim that the heavens are biologically pregnant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا ... تَقْدِيرُ ... ٱلْعَلِيمِ

activation_trace.role: Sky, cloud, and what rises overhead supply the carrier domain.
Each layer's own affair supplies the latent content or process it carries.
Reaching a measured limit supplies maturation and timed release.
Knowledge of the concealed process and its outcome supplies exact oversight.
An inward load or fruit supplies the gestational carrying image.
A load in sky or cloud explicitly transfers carrying into the celestial domain.
An enclosing plant sheath supplies protected latency before emergence.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the eventual manifestation of the carried process.

changed_reading.before: Each heaven statically contains an assigned affair.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each layer carries a latent process or load toward a measured emergence under complete knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the morning branch of مصابيح with a context branch where النفس is the opening of dawn, producing a breathing-horizon image. It remains anchored in the focus's lamps, two-day timing, and knowing estimation, while 41:37 and 41:53 supply day-night and horizon-self correspondences. Downstream prose should retain it as a temporal and phenomenological analogy, not a claim that the sky literally breathes.

activation_trace.role: Morning and first light let the lamps activate temporal opening as well as luminous objects.
A temporal duration supplies the measured rhythm within which openings recur.
Measured limit supplies regulation of the light-dark rhythm.
Night and its darkness supply the closure phase of the cycle.
Day opening through light supplies the expansion phase paired with morning.
The opening of dawn like a breath supplies the explicit bridge between self, breath, and first light.
Distant horizons locate the visible opening where the rhythm is perceived.

changed_reading.before: The lamps are fixed celestial lights within a measured construction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they also mark a measured horizon rhythm in which darkness closes and daylight opens like breath.

strongest_changes: The seven heavens shift from static layers to differentiated units in an articulated cosmic communiqué.
Immediate creation context turns each heaven's affair into an operating charge within an obedient provisioning and preservation network.
The mighty protected book makes guarding readable as integrity protection for transmitted order, not only spatial defense.
Horizon signs and comprehensive witness make the lamps evidentiary marks paired with signs in selves.
The closing enclosure of every thing unites local guarding, complete knowledge, and total custody.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly couples the focus vocabulary with revelation, willing response, material testimony, protected transmission, measured emergence, and horizon evidence. Most diagnostic is the closing ح و ط inventory, whose preservation and knowledge branches directly recombine حِفْظًا and ٱلْعَلِيمِ.
remaining_uncertainties: أَمْرَهَا may denote each heaven's operative charge, its affair, or a decree; several models depend on the stronger functional reading.
The parallel between the guarded heaven and the inviolable book is mechanically coherent but may be analogical rather than an intended identity.
The legal-jurisdiction model depends on carrying the later adjudicative use of ق ض ي back into a focus form dominated by completion and making.
The marked-membrane, gestational, and breathing-dawn outliers depend on non-dominant or cross-domain branches and require explicit exploratory qualification.
